recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: z80 processors from the seventies still humming in forgotten machines
clear august night in san francisco, wind through the gaps
platforms designed to hook, hold, and harvest attention
late summer dusk after a twenty-three degree day
agents spun up from a phone before sunrise
summer fog rolling back from the bay at nightfall

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Keep a dying Z80 chip alive by swiping power through corroded PCB traces before each clock cycle expires — every routed trace adds a glowing register bit to your chain.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe to redirect current across lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: watching register bits stack into a satisfying 8-bit score display after each clean cycle
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: clock speed doubles every ten seconds, traces corrode and shrink
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: amber phosphor terminal with CRT scanlines

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag paths through rolling summer fog banks to deliver dawn light to dormant agent nodes scattered across SF hilltops before sunrise hits.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag to carve fog tunnels between hill nodes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: fog parting to reveal neon agent icons lighting up one by one
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind scatters drawn paths faster as horizon glow intensifies
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor fog gradients over wireframe city silhouette

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick falling notification hooks into matching color bins before they latch onto a scrolling feed — keep the timeline clean for sixty seconds.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: satisfying snap and dissolve when a hook misses the feed entirely
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: feed scroll speed increases while decoy hooks and blended colors multiply
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout UI icons in muted pastels

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap in rhythm to stack surgical commit blocks onto a shipping timeline — each beat is one tiny edit, not a sweeping rewrite, before the SF sunrise timer expires.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: tap on beat to drop commit blocks
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: combo multiplier when edits land in the groove and the stack glows gold
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: tempo ramps and beat windows shrink as bay horizon turns orange
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe sunrise over the golden gate
